subject.title: fix(infra): clarify Allow Always unavailable message for one-shot commands

question: Should maintainers repair this PR to cover Control UI and current-head proof, or choose a different overlapping PR as the canonical fix for the redirected-command Allow Always wording bug?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same root cause, and this branch is mechanically incomplete but still mergeable; automation should not choose the canonical approval-surface branch or accept partial UI coverage without maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair this branch first
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only after it adds Control UI reason-specific copy, focused UI coverage, and fresh current-head real prompt proof.

options.title: Promote an overlapping PR
options.body: Use a sibling PR as canonical only after it is updated, mergeable, and still has positive real behavior proof for the full surface.

options.title: Pause duplicate branches
options.body: Hold the overlapping PRs open until an approval-area owner chooses the implementation shape and closes the rest against that choice.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only after it adds Control UI reason-specific copy, focused UI coverage, and fresh current-head real prompt proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history owns both the generic approval prompt copy and the native approval lifecycle surface involved in this branch.
